_description: Single straight vessel driven by a half-sine inlet flow pulse (data/inlet_flow_sine.csv), terminated by the 0D 'windkessel' model from hemo1d_couplings -- a two-compartment RC ladder: matched proximal impedance R1 = rho*c0/A0 (r1 < 0), an arteriole compartment (r,c) and a capillary compartment (r,c) draining to p_out = 0. Mirrors Toro (2021) Fig. 2's vascular bed with the venous side collapsed to a fixed pressure; set compartments to a single entry for the classic three-element Windkessel. The 'external' + 'model' + 'params' shape is generic: any registered model is reached the same way.
